moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: The Hundred 2026 season culminates with both the Men's and Women's Finals Day at Lord's Cricket Ground in London on Sunday, August 16.

source.l: The Hundred Official Website / BBC Sport

angles.name: Finals Anticipation
angles.copy: Who's lifting the trophy? The Hundred Finals Day is just over a week away at Lord's! Get ready for thrilling cricket as the men's and women's champions are crowned. #TheHundred

angles.name: Lord's Buzz
angles.copy: The Home of Cricket, Lord's, is set to host The Hundred Finals next Sunday! Expect electric atmosphere and world-class action right here in London. #Lord'sCricket

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup holders Manchester City, will be held at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: Cardiff is gearing up for a huge football clash next Sunday! The Community Shield sees Arsenal take on Manchester City at Principality Stadium. Who's winning the first silverware of the season? #CommunityShield

angles.name: Welsh Football Focus
angles.copy: All eyes on Principality Stadium next weekend as the Community Shield comes to Cardiff! Man City vs Arsenal – a massive game to kick off the new football season. #CardiffFootball

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' to Wembley Stadium for multiple dates starting next week, including August 14, 15, 16, 18, and 19.

angles.name: Wembley Calling
angles.copy: Get ready, London! The Weeknd's 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' hits Wembley Stadium next week for a series of epic nights. Who's got tickets for Abel Tesfaye's massive show? #TheWeeknd

angles.name: Anticipation Build
angles.copy: It's almost time! The Weeknd is bringing the 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' to the UK. Five huge nights at Wembley Stadium are just around the corner, starting August 14th. #WembleyStadium

moments.title: Ariana Grande O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande kicks off her highly anticipated ten-night residency at London's The O2 Arena starting August 15th, as part of 'The Eternal Sunshine Tour'.

source.l: The O2 Arena Official Website / Ticketmaster

angles.name: Ariana Takes Over O2
angles.copy: London, get ready for an 'Eternal Sunshine' takeover! Ariana Grande's 10-night residency at The O2 kicks off next Saturday. Which date are you seeing her? #ArianaGrande

angles.name: Pop Event of the Week
angles.copy: The biggest pop event of the week is almost here! Ariana Grande starts her epic run at The O2 next Saturday. Expect stunning vocals and a show to remember. #EternalSunshine

moments.title: Ivan Toney Charged with Assault
moments.blurb: England forward Ivan Toney, 30, has been charged with assault following an incident at a London nightclub in December, police confirmed today.

angles.name: Footballer in the News
angles.copy: Breaking news in football: England forward Ivan Toney has been charged with assault. The 30-year-old is set to appear in court in September. More on this story across the Nation Network. #IvanToney

angles.name: London Footballer News
angles.copy: London news today: England's Ivan Toney has been charged with assault following an incident in a Soho nightclub. He acknowledges the charge and looks forward to clearing his name. #LondonNews
